name: Dead of Night (The Complete Series)
overview: Welcome to Viktorville: a town where inter-dimensional flux-core portals open daily and a menagerie of dangerous creatures crawl through them. Join Viktor Corporation enforcement officers, Status and AK, as they protect Viktorville from dinosaurs, killer robots, golems, Basilisks, Sligaks, Goldenballs, Drainers, The Drolic, and much more!
